items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, Kenny Clark. Yeah, Kenny Clark on drums and Sonny White on piano, was it? Yeah.

ctx.x: In 1941 you pared this big band down to a sextet, and that’s the one that included Dizzy Gillespie.
Yes, that’s right, at Kelly’s Stables [phonetic].
